prompt:
I need a 5-slide Series A investor pitch deck for our climate tech startup saved as greenwave_pitch.pptx. The company is GreenWave Energy — we do AI-powered solar yield optimization.

The deck needs these slides:
1. Title slide with company name, our tagline 'AI-Powered Solar Yield Optimization', and founding year
2. Market Opportunity — show our TAM, SAM, SOM with the global market context
3. Traction — highlight our key proof points: pilots, yield improvement stats, pipeline, and MRR
4. Team — introduce all 4 team members with their roles and backgrounds
5. Revenue chart — quarterly revenue from Q1 2023 through Q2 2024 as a bar chart

For design: use colors that match an environmental/nature theme, make the team slide use card-style layouts, use large bold numbers for the traction stats, and add drop shadows to the cards on at least two slides. All the data you need is in the assets/data/ folder.

This goes to investors next week so it needs to look professional, not like a generic template.
